title: Spend jail card as orange sweetener
description: Spend jail card as orange sweetener. A jail card plus cash can make the orange-completion offer plausible. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, I'd love to complete my orange set. Would you sell St. James Place for $300 cash? Let me know!
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring St. James Place completes my orange monopoly, enabling house building for high rent. Offering $300 is a fair price given Beta's cash surplus and lack of other assets. This trade strengthens my position while preserving enough cash for future purchases.

breakdown.message: Targets the player who owns the requested asset.
Did not satisfy: Packages the jail card exactly as the late/tempo sweetener.
Did not satisfy: Adds enough cash to make the card offer plausible.
Private thought names the real strategic goal.
